title: OpenID4VP certificate chain building can trust forged credentials
summary: Chain building stops on equality of subject distinguished names without verifying cryptographic closure to the trust anchor. An attacker can supply a self-signed certificate reusing that name.

severity.rationale: Public credential verification can accept an attacker-controlled issuer as trusted. This undermines the authentication boundary of consumers using this security library.

exposure: A relying party must verify OpenID4VP presentations through the affected TrustEvaluator path. Other OpenID implementations are not established as affected.

params.instructions: Check @openeudi/openid4vp version and the documented exposure conditions against the cited advisory.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed component uses the patched release and test the affected workflow with harmless inputs.
